description: Retrieves a Salesforce account by ID and returns the fields represented in the account response schema.

account_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the account to retrieve.
account_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the account you want to retrieve. You can copy it from the account's URL in Salesforce (it usually starts with '001').
account_id.title: Account Id

name: get_account

AccountAttributes.description: Metadata object containing the Salesforce object type and resource URL.

type.description: The Salesforce object type, always 'Account' for Account records.
type.title: Type

url.description: The REST API resource URL for this specific Account record.
url.title: Url

AccountAttributes.title: AccountAttributes

GetAccountResponse.description: Salesforce Account record with all standard fields.

Website.description: The website of this account, for example, www.acme.com.
Website.title: Website

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the Account has been moved to the Recycle Bin (true) or not (false).
IsDeleted.title: Is Deleted

AccountNumber.description: Account number assigned to this account (not the unique ID).
AccountNumber.title: Account Number

BillingAddress.description: Compound field containing the billing address. Read-only compound field composed of BillingStreet, BillingCity, BillingState, BillingPostalCode, BillingCountry, BillingLatitude, BillingLongitude, and BillingGeocodeAccuracy.
BillingAddress.title: Billing Address

TickerSymbol.description: Stock market ticker symbol for this account.
TickerSymbol.title: Ticker Symbol

BillingLongitude.description: Used with BillingLatitude to specify the precise geolocation of a billing address. Acceptable values are numbers between -180 and 180 with up to 15 decimal places.
BillingLongitude.title: Billing Longitude

Jigsaw.description: References the ID of a company in Data.com.
Jigsaw.title: Jigsaw

Site.description: Name of the account's location, for example, Headquarters or London.
